Welcome to the University of Surrey, a leading campus university in Guildford.
 
Our two campuses are home to over 300 undergraduate courses, hundreds of student clubs and societies, a buzzing nightlife, and cosy, welcoming accommodation - all in the UK’s safest university town*, just 32 minutes from London via our local train station.
 
With award-winning** employability support, dedicated wellbeing services, expert academic advice, and purpose-built facilities, Surrey could be the perfect next step in both your academic and personal journey.
 
Find out more about us - https://www.surrey.ac.uk 
 
*Complete University, Guide 2025
**SILVER in the Career Prospects category for the 2025 Whatuni? Student Choice Awards.
